fieldValues.title: B8. Learn
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
Aim: turn outcomes into memory and changed practice (harvest, measure, retrospect).

Tried: the September unit walk's Harvest; srs-context and the dream cycle; indicators I1 to I4, falsifiers and return_when; the handbook watcher; the big audits (10-08, 10-23).
fieldValues.tensions:
- Trade-off: refine ↔ deliver (trigram line 1). Practice leans hard to refine: process against product merges, week of 10-12 66 to 26, week of 10-19 197 to 83, about 0 before October; 071eadb2 (no core changes until the process is refined); the owner, 10-23: 'stuck at line 1'.
- Gone wrong: I2 to I4 never computed (clerk#25); falsifiers never evaluated; no retrospective; the watcher has no trigger; harvest cost one PR per unit (2026-09-11); learning arrives in bursts as audits, and their remedies are re-planned rather than done.
